blocks.text: Key Features and Benefits:Fujitsu Stylistic Q5010 TabletIntel Celeron N40204GB RAM 64GB SSDWindows 11 pro 64 Bit10.1in FHD Touchscreen DisplayType-C2×WebcamWIFI+BluetoothJapanese Keyboard

items: 【10.1 FHD Touchscreen Tablet PC】This Fujitsu Tablet features a 10.1-inch (1920×1200) high-definition touchscreen, delivering crisp detail and true-to-life colors. It supports touch operation and comes with a Japanese keyboard, accommodating different usage preferences.
【Specs】This Stylistic Q5010 Touchscreen Laptop features a Type-C port. Equipped with front and rear cameras, it facilitates video conferencing, on-site photography, archiving, and other scenarios.

【CPU】This Fujitsu Stylistic Q5010 tablet features an Intel Celeron N4020 processor paired with integrated Intel UHD Graphics 600, enabling smooth operation of everyday office software and web browsing while meeting light multimedia processing needs.

【RAM&SSD】This Stylistic Q5010 Laptop features the golden combination of 4GB RAM and a 64GB SSD. The 4GB memory ensures smooth multitasking, while the 64GB SSD delivers significantly faster read/write speeds compared to traditional mechanical hard drives.

【Win 11】This Windows 11 tablet comes pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro, delivering a smoother user interface, enhanced multitasking capabilities, and a comprehensive suite of native productivity tools.
